name: Destroy Mummy
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Tap ceiling block to drop scarab and scare mummy.
Tap curtain door to make mummy step back.
Tap basket to release snake and scare mummy.
Tap pharaoh scepter to shock mummy.
Tap sarcophagus to trap mummy inside.
Tap potion bottle to spill stink and scare mummy.
Tap golden fan to push hot air/fire at mummy.
Tap roof tiles to drop boulder on mummy.
Tap shadow to summon black cat and scare mummy.
Tap torch to burn mummy and clear level.
